newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ASEAN foreign ministers to meet Aug 11 on Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: ASEAN foreign ministers to meet Aug 11 on Cambodia.

text.p: Foreign ministers of the Association of South East Asian Nations have agreed to meet in Singapore on August 11 to discuss Cambodia's political crisis, Philippine Foreign Secretary Domingo Siazon said on Tuesday.
Siazon will convene the meeting as chairman of the ASEAN standing committee.
The meeting is aimed at briefing members of the nine-nation group on a visit by a three-man ASEAN delegation to Phnom Penh on August 2 during which they met Cambodian co-prime minister Hun Sen.
"The special ASEAN foreign ministers meeting will also consider subsequent steps that ASEAN should take with respect to its consultations on the question of Cambodia," Siazon said in a statement.
Cambodia has been in turmoil since Hun Sen ousted his senior co-premier, Prince Norodom Ranariddh, on July 6 after two days of fighting in Phnom Penh.
Hun Sen subsequently rejected attempts on mediation and warned against any interference by outside powers in Cambodia's affairs.
The ASEAN team to Cambodia was made up of Siazon and Foreign Ministers Ali Alatas of Indonesia and Prachuab Chaiyasan of Thailand.
